column1: # kayfabe board-specific constants (owner rulings 2026-10-11 section AH; matrix finding F-6). STATUS: LIVE, 2026-10-15.
# A (key, die) here has TWO OR MORE boards of the same die that answered differently, so the pair (die, driver branch) - the
# key of measured_constants.tsv - is too coarse for it: no table row may serve it, on any branch, and none may exist
# (consttab::parse_board_specific enforces both). The only source is the host's own answer to the identical request (tier 2,
# kf_abi::gssreplay at realize); where the host did not answer, the guest is refused by name and the refusal is counted.
# `seen` lists the measurements as `SKU=value` separated by `;` (product names only: never a serial, UUID or board identity).
# The registry is itself checked against traces/constants_measure_20261014b/tier2_summary.tsv by tests/consttab_data.rs, tests/consttab_loader.rs and tests/gpu_types_wiring.rs: every
# (key, die) whose boards disagree there MUST be listed here.
